detail_observations.label: What they say
detail_observations.text:
Lars Orson
===Parley Dialog with Reingraf===
"Reingraf," you say, "I need to speak to you about what you know." "I'm sorry, CHARACTER_RACE," he says, "but this is a very dangerous time to be around me. I would recommend you leave." "I was sent here by Lars Orson," you say. "He told me to seek you out." "That little worm," he says, with a sneer. "Why would he send you to me." "I'm looking into a plot," you say. "It seems to involve quite a few people." Reingraf look at you curiously. "This wouldn't happen to involve bread or necromancers, would it? Possibly a bow?" "It would," you say. "Why? What is going on?" "It would seem you are looking into the same plot I am," he says. He holds out a loaf of bread. "I tracked the wheat in this bread here, but I've been stonewalled by Lord Renton." He checks a large knife he has, then puts it back in a sheath. "What does that bread have to do with anything though?" you ask. "The bread is part of the plot," he says, wild-eyed. "I bought some for my starving family. There wasn't enough for everyone, so I didn't eat. Every one of them slowly turned into crazed monsters. Undead." "I've tracked the wheat, and its effects, here," he says, "as well as this symbol." He holds out a symbol for the group you've seen before. "They've sent this wheat up to Tursh, out to Halgarad, and over to Three Rivers," he continues. "The bow, I found on a man. I followed him from Veskal's Exchange. I questioned him about the symbol, as someone said he was part of the circle. He, however, got away." "What does the bow have to do with anything?" you ask. "The man with the bow was part of the circle," Reingraf says. "I found vulmane Heartseeker arrows on him as well. That only spells assassination. He was headed here, but when I arrived, he had already left." "So, not only is Renton Keep making bread that turns people into zombies," you say, "but they've chartered an assassination?" "That is what it appears to be," he says. "If you want more information, you'll have to get it out of Lord Renton. I can't stand to speak to that weakling anymore."

findings.observation: Heading displays Level 4, Diplomacy, Renton Keep and Thestra with upper-floor location text. Details instead gives -73266, -37, 49078. These are source contexts, not verified target spawns.

Objectives name Reingraf Morson and Lord Renton; the final objective spells Reingraft. Details starts with Lars Olson, while most dialogue labels Lars Orson. Preserve spellings without resolving identities by name.

Description locates Reingraf in Veers Farm barn at -80105, -5366, 48436; Notes prints -79942, -5400, 48436. Description locates Lord Marcus Renton on the first floor at -72936, 1283, 48360. Notes gives only Renton Keep for him. Preserve all coordinate contexts without correction.

Five recorded disagreements concern loc (fandom), next quest (fandom), next quest (silkyvenom), prev quest (silkyvenom), and starts npc (fandom). The displayed labels do not supply all alternative values; unresolved collisions remain withheld.

While-you-carry dialogue contains literal collapsed-div markup and CHARACTER_RACE. Finishing dialogue is the placeholder <stuff when you turn in the quest>. Details names Lord Marcus Renton for hand-in; the placeholder is under Lars Orson. Do not convert this into an operative completion mechanism.

Notes retain four Reingraf card filenames and five Lord Marcus Renton card filenames in unrendered wiki tables. Sweeper Agent : 4 appears in both contexts without defined semantics. Filenames do not establish canonical card IDs, complete encounter decks or rewards.

Taking/offering dialogue preserves spelling and punctuation variants attributed to silkyvenom and fandom. Another account is attributed to photographed in game by the archive operator. These are mirror attributions; original linked sources were not fetched and this is not independent corroboration.

Details prints Previous By the Trail of Dead or Risky Business or Winding Roads or Exchanging Information and Next Alley Whispers, Word On The Street. Navigation does not prove enforced prerequisites. Repeatable yes and Coin reward 50 are displayed with no eligibility rules or denomination.
